title: HyperET: Efficient Training in Hyperbolic Space for Multi-modal Large Language Models

layout.note: A large rounded module on the left holds a pink panel of four matrices and the pretrained weight matrix; a small vertical Input to Output block on the right is the source of two dashed zoom lines; below run a chevron banner under the matrices and a two-row legend.

lesson: Present a family of structured parameterisations as same-size grids whose coloured cells show which entries are tunable, and order them with a spectrum banner (efficient to flexible) beneath; tie the small block diagram to the zoomed module with dashed lines.
